title: Turkey Chili Mac
description: Chef John's turkey chili mac recipe uses simple seasonings, such as chili powder, ground dried chipotle, cocoa powder, cumin, cinnamon, and oregano.
ingredients: 1 teaspoon salt, or more to taste
2 tablespoons chili powder, or to taste
0.5 teaspoon ground dried chipotle pepper, or more to taste
4 cups chicken broth, or more as needed
1 (10 ounce) can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers
1 (15 ounce) can pinto beans, rinsed and drained

steps.text: Heat olive oil in a pot over medium-high heat. Add onion and 1 teaspoon salt; cook and stir until onion starts to soften and turns translucent, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, combine chili powder, cumin, black pepper, cocoa powder, ground chipotle, oregano, and cinnamon in a small bowl. Add spice mixture and garlic to onion; cook and stir, 1 to 2 minutes.
Stir in 4 cups chicken broth, diced tomatoes with chiles, and tomato sauce; increase heat to high and bring to a simmer. Reduce heat to medium-low; simmer, stirring occasionally, for 15 minutes.
Add turkey and more chicken broth if needed; cook, stirring occasionally, 15 minutes more.

Taste; adjust seasonings as needed. Increase heat to high; bring to a boil. Stir in pinto beans and elbow macaroni; cover pot tightly with a lid. Cook, covered, until pasta is just barely tender, about 5 minutes.
Turn off heat; remove lid and stir well. Cover; let sit for 5 minutes. Uncover; stir in Cheddar cheese and serve immediately.

video.description: Make this delicious dinner recipe using your thanksgiving leftovers. In this video, Chef John makes turkey chili mac with pinto beans and elbow macaroni. This dish is made with a combination of vegetables, turkey, and, surprisingly, cinnamon and cocoa powder. The end result is a comfortable, tasty, and different stew that is perfect for a post-Thanksgiving main course.
